bagPolicy.summary: Mercedes-Benz Stadium allows clear bags made of plastic, vinyl, or PVC up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small non-clear bags up to 4.5” x 6.5”. All other bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small non-clear bags up to 4.5” x 6.5”
prohibited: Bags that do not meet the specified guidelines
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available in the Red Deck and Silver Deck of the Georgia World Congress Center, subject to availability. MARTA offers a convenient and affordable option at $2.50 each way, with stops near the stadium.

rideshare.note: Use Rideshare Zone 1 on Northside Drive in front of Georgia World Congress Center Building C. Follow the signs along the Northside Drive sidewalk. Allow for longer waits after events.

concessions.note: Mercedes-Benz Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including vegetarian and gluten-avoiding choices. Highlights include a Vegan Smokehouse Sausage and Quinoa Bowl. Beverage options range from sodas to premium draft beers.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair and companion seating is on every level. For most events, buy accessible seats on Ticketmaster by turning on "show accessible tickets" in the filters; one companion seat is next to the wheelchair space and others are nearby. On event day, any Guest Services Center can help with accessible relocations, subject to availability.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: A mobile ticket is required for entry. The Box Office is near Gate 1 off Northside Drive; it is closed on non-event days and open on event days for ticket resolution only, with hours that vary by event.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
